Elavon renews partnership with Sage to simplify payments for growing businesses
results.description: LONDON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- #fintech--Elavon, the merchant payment division of U.S. Bank and one of Europe’s leading global merchant acquirers, and Sage, the leader in accounting, financial, HR and payroll technology for small and mid-sized businesses, have renewed their long-standing partnership to continue delivering simple, seamless and scalable payment solutions to even more Sage customers across the United Kingdom and Ireland.
